Names of 4 roads, named after Razakars, changed
2017-03-08T17:12:48+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/country/names-4-roads-named-after-razakars-changed-1372768

Names of four roads in Magura, which were named after war criminals, have been changed. The act was carried out today as per a High Court directive.

Three of the roads are under Magura municipality and the other in Binodpur upazila.

Mayor Khurshid Haider Tutul gave out the order to change names of three roads in Magura municipality today, our local correspondent reports.

“The freedom fighters are highly pleased with the court order,” said Mollah Nobuyat Ali, district commander of freedom fighters.
